Focused merge primitive inventory: selected gix-revision merge_base source/tests and gix-merge tree source/baseline tests inspected; 5 merge-focused test attributes counted across merge-base and tree baseline tests. Focused blob merge inventory: selected gix-merge builtin text/binary driver source and blob merge tests inspected; 22 blob-focused test attributes counted across selected gix-merge blob source/tests. Focused directory rename heuristic slice maps renamed internal plugin entry files during directory rename similarity scoring. Focused SSH receive-pack adapter slice maps ssh:// and scp-like URL parsing, git-receive-pack command quoting, and injected stream handoff without shelling out to ssh. Focused smart HTTP auth/session slice maps caller-supplied auth headers, managed header validation, Git-Protocol propagation on POST, and Set-Cookie propagation from discovery to receive-pack POST. Focused smart HTTP redirect slice maps gix-transport redirect base-url reconciliation, same-authority redirects, safe http-to-https upgrades, effective-base reuse for POST, and rejection of cross-host or downgrade redirects. Focused smart HTTP proxy slice maps http.proxy-style proxy selection, noProxy matching, Basic proxy credentials from URLs or explicit options, credential-helper callback boundaries, PHP stream-context proxy wiring without leaking proxy authorization into origin headers, proxyAuthMethod normalization, and curl-style SOCKS proxy declaration typing for injected requesters. Focused strict-best rename heuristic slice maps Gitoxide rewrite tracking behavior where a renamed directory is selected from similar candidates only when one target is strictly best, preserving ambiguity rejection for equal candidates. Focused directory rename target-collision slice maps a renamed WordPress plugin directory colliding with an independently added target directory while the old directory is modified.
